tests.public_surface: pegen.build C-extension parser generated from a gather (sep.elem+) grammar; selected body calls only the local check_input_strings_for_grammar helper
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestCParser method shipped verbatim in eval_tests.patch at base_commit; selected body invokes only self.check_input_strings_for_grammar, the same surface as the six original TestCParser F2P selectors; no newly added _PyPegen_*/PyPegen_* source symbol is named in the selected body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion (no authoring). The §5.5 authored-opacity gate targets newly authored aug tests; this is a committed-original test selected by precedent. Gather requires a separator between every pair and at least one element, killing the C-generator gather and repeat1 mutants.

requirement_sections: The new proposed PEG parser > Grammar actions
tests.public_surface: pegen.build C-extension parser generated from a mutually left-recursive grammar; selected body calls only the local check_input_strings_for_grammar helper
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestCParser method in eval_tests.patch; selected body invokes only self.check_input_strings_for_grammar; no newly added source symbol named in the body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion. Indirect (mutual) left recursion only parses when the C generator memoizes left-recursive rules and grows the seed, distinguishing golden from the left-recursion mutants.

tests.public_surface: pegen.build C-extension parser generated from a hidden/indirect left-recursive grammar; selected body calls only the local check_input_strings_for_grammar helper

tests.rationale: Selection expansion. Hidden left recursion with valid and invalid cases stresses the C-generator left-recursion memoization.

requirement_sections: The new proposed PEG parser > Syntax > Grammar Expressions
tests.public_surface: pegen make_parser + parse_string over a grammar using the optional operator (...)?
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestPegen method in eval_tests.patch; selected body invokes pegen.testutil make_parser/parse_string (the same pegen module surface the committed first-sets aug test uses); no newly added C source symbol named in the body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion. Asserting the tree with the optional group present and absent (None) kills the optional-is-mandatory mutant; parsing the '?' grammar exercises the metagrammar the question-becomes-repeat1 mutant alters.

requirement_sections: The new proposed PEG parser > Syntax > Grammar Expressions
tests.public_surface: pegen make_parser + parse_string over a grammar using the bracketed optional form [ ... ]
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestPegen method in eval_tests.patch; selected body invokes make_parser/parse_string; no newly added C source symbol named in the body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion. The bracketed optional must accept input with and without the optional group, pinning golden against the optional-is-mandatory mutant.

requirement_sections: The new proposed PEG parser > Syntax > Grammar Expressions
tests.public_surface: pegen make_parser + parse_string over a grammar using the zero-or-more operator thing*
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestPegen method in eval_tests.patch; selected body invokes make_parser/parse_string; no newly added C source symbol named in the body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion. Parsing a single element (empty repetition yields []) requires zero-or-more to accept zero matches, killing the repeat0-requires-one and loop0-named-loop1 mutants; parsing the '*' grammar exercises the metagrammar the star-becomes-repeat1 mutant alters.

requirement_sections: The new proposed PEG parser > Syntax > Grammar Expressions
tests.public_surface: pegen make_parser + parse_string over a grammar using the one-or-more operator thing+
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestPegen method in eval_tests.patch; selected body invokes make_parser/parse_string; no newly added C source symbol named in the body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion. The body asserts a multi-element parse and a SyntaxError on single-element input, killing the repeat1-allows-empty mutant.

requirement_sections: The new proposed PEG parser > Syntax > Grammar Expressions
tests.public_surface: pegen make_parser + parse_string over a grammar using the gather operator sep.elem+
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestPegen method in eval_tests.patch; selected body invokes make_parser/parse_string; no newly added C source symbol named in the body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion. The exact tree for a comma-separated list pins element/separator structure and ordering, killing gather mutants that ignore/repeat the separator or reverse the sequence.

requirement_sections: The new proposed PEG parser > Syntax > Grammar Expressions
tests.public_surface: pegen make_parser + parse_string over a grammar using positive (&) and negative (!) lookahead
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestPegen method in eval_tests.patch; selected body invokes make_parser/parse_string; no newly added C source symbol named in the body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion. The grammar uses both positive (&'.') and negative (!(target '=')) lookahead; the asserted tree only holds when both predicates are correct, killing the lookahead-inversion mutants.

requirement_sections: The new proposed PEG parser > Grammar actions
tests.public_surface: pegen parse_string + generate_parser over a left-recursive grammar; asserts left_recursive flags and the parse tree
internal_symbol_check: committed-suite precedent: pre-existing TestPegen method in eval_tests.patch; selected body invokes parse_string/generate_parser; no newly added C source symbol named in the body
tests.rationale: Selection expansion. The asserted left-recursive tree for '1 + 2 + 3' only forms when memoized results advance the input position, killing the memoized-hit-does-not-advance mutant.
